```java title="Java"

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        var result = HtmlToMarkdownRs.convert("<p>Before rule.</p><hr><p>After rule.</p>", ConversionOptions.builder().build());
        System.out.println(result);
    }
}
```
